name: Grace
overview: Scripture reveals grace as God's sovereign and faithful favor bestowed upon His chosen people, not because of their merit or number, but because of His love and covenant faithfulness, as seen in Deuteronomy 7:6-9. This grace is demonstrated in God's protection and redemption, such as sparing Abraham from sin (Genesis 20:6) and counting his faith as righteousness (Genesis 15:6). Grace is foundational to God's covenant relationship, highlighting His unchanging commitment to those who love and obey Him.
